subject.title: fix(gateway): replace buggy isPrivateOrLoopbackHost with canonical net.ts import

question: After the import defect is fixed, should maintainers require real gateway pricing-cache refresh proof for this external PR or waive that proof gate based on source inspection and focused tests?
rationale: Automation cannot verify the contributor's real gateway setup, and the changed classifier controls compatibility-sensitive catalog fetch decisions for configured provider URLs.

options.title: Require real gateway proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or logs from a real gateway pricing-cache refresh showing a CGNAT/private endpoint skipped and a public endpoint still fetched.

options.title: Waive proof after import repair
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally accept the remaining proof risk once the duplicate import is fixed, using the source-level evidence and regression tests as sufficient.

recommendation.title: Require real gateway proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or logs from a real gateway pricing-cache refresh showing a CGNAT/private endpoint skipped and a public endpoint still fetched.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent pricing-cache work makes this the strongest code-path routing candidate for the proof-sufficiency call.
